verdict.rationale: Rate limits and concurrency caps are a fair axis for a paid search API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents per-second or monthly request limits, concurrency caps, or tier-by-tier quotas. The only plan-related evidence is a community remark that users can cancel a standard plan and sign up for a separate AI Inference plan. That covers ToS compliance and plan switching, not documented limits, so it does not deliver the story.
